connections.why: Personal identity, lifestyle and culture broaden out into local, national and global areas of interest
The wider national and international world connects to school life, study choices and the world of work
Identity, values and culture shape the educational and career paths a learner chooses to pursue
The identity and culture context supplies the everyday vocabulary practised across all four skills
Local and global topics are core contexts for listening, reading and transactional speaking tasks
School and world-of-work themes are common prompts for the productive writing and speaking skills
